notes.title: It's a Trading Card! It's a Plane! It's... no, no we were right the first time, it's definitely a Trading Card.
notes.notes:
Whilst venturing through the varied and colourful landscapes of A Pixel Story, and meeting the weird and wonderful cast of characters, you can now earn our new amazing Steam Trading Cards! If you're lucky enough to collect a full set, you'll get an even more awesome goodies in the form of A Pixel Story badges and backgrounds! 

So now, as well as the potent feeling of' do-goodery' you should get from freeing the people from an oppressive system, you can also gain the much more tangible benefit of digital cards worth actual real life money.

This is a mini-prelude to the much larger update (coming soon) at which point A Pixel Story will be playable on Mac, as well as a few small bonuses in game too. An offer tantalizing enough to draw you from the best the summer sales will have to offer, we have no doubt.

notes.title: A Pixel Story Update
notes.notes:
Patch Notes [v1.4.1f1]

- Fixed an issue causing the "Hat about abit... Possibly alot" achievement to reset.
- Fixed a rare issue which resulted in the player not spawning.
- Fixed bug resulting in the player spawning underneath the eraser in the recycle bin.
